args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` to address **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity).

## Details

- **CVE-2026-31337**: Unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
- **Affected versions**: `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`
- **Fixed in**: `2.9.4` (2.x line) and `3.1.0` (3.x line)

This change bumps the pinned version in `requirements.txt` to the fixed `2.9.4` within the existing 2.x major line, minimizing risk of breaking API changes.

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337`.

Requesting review from @alex.
